newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot to fly to Faro in Portugal in June.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot to fly to Faro in Portugal in June.

text.p: Aeroflot -Russian International Airlines said on Tuesday it would begin new flights from Moscow to Faro in Portugal from June 13.
Aeroflot spokesman Alexander Luchaninov said the company would operate Airbus A-310 jets on Fridays on the route.
He said Aeroflot had decided to fly to Faro to meet demand from Russian tourists seeking a holiday in southern Portugal. "We see this route as very promising," he said.
Aeroflot last week began regular flights between Moscow and Monastir in Tunisia with wide-bodied Ilyushin Il-86 jets.
